I just opened cslib#704, which formalizes some results in the following classic paper:

Alpern, Bowen; Schneider, Fred B. (1985). "Defining liveness". Information Processing Letters. 21 (4): 181–185.

Your comments will be appreciated.

BTW, here is where I learned that the topology I want is the product topology:
#Is there code for X? > Question about a topology on infinite sequences
